prompt:
Subject: An arsenic specimen in a laboratory.

Composition: Show a small sealed specimen vial containing dark silvery-gray crystalline arsenic on a laboratory tray beside a compact periodic-table tile showing As and 33. A gloved hand steadies the tray; keep the material contained, with no poison recipe or ingestion scene.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. Allow only the chemical symbol As and atomic number 33 on the periodic-table tile; no other text, captions, speech balloons, labels, logos or watermark.
Style reference invidious.png: rounded friendly 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading.
en: A sealed vial of arsenic crystals beside a periodic-table tile marked As and 33.
ja: As・33と記された元素タイルの隣に置かれた、密封されたヒ素結晶の瓶。
